props.name: currentUser
props.type: { avatar?: string; id: string; name: string }
props.comment: Replaces the auth provider's identity as the user who is announced.

props.name: heartbeatMs
props.comment: How often the announce is republished. Default 15000.

props.name: maxAvatars
props.comment: How many avatars to show before the rest collapse into a `+N` count. Default 5.

props.name: staleMs
props.comment: A user unheard for longer than this is dropped. Default 30000.

props.name: topic
props.comment: Defaults to the presence topic of the resource and record contexts.
